blocks.text: *Gear that shapes your kit, your defense, and your look.*

Your weapon is more than a stat stick — it **grants the active skills** on your hotbar (see *Skills*). Every weapon is a real 3D object your character holds, and swapping weapons swaps your whole kit.

Every weapon owns a **distinct playstyle** — one clear reason to wield it. That playstyle isn't a design label: each of the twelve is the last surviving trace of one of the **Twelve Unwritten**, and how the weapon fights *is* how that person fought. None of them was ever named — only described by the deed witnesses remembered. They fall into three families:

rows: Win duels with precise single-target bursts and timed defense.
The One Who Cleared the Road
Delete whole groups with huge cleaves.
Deny enemies their turn — stun and knock them back.
The One Who Moved the Line
Reposition the fight — pull enemies in and impale them.
Protect your allies by absorbing all the attention. *(off-hand — pair it with a one-handed weapon)*
Win through mobility and spacing — kite and never get touched.
Land one devastating shot, then reload.
The One Who Burned the Field
Dominate whole areas with destructive magic.
The One Who Brought Them Back
Slowly overwhelm enemies with stacking curses.

blocks.text: Each weapon type has a deep pool of skills, and **every weapon that drops rolls its own kit** from that pool — how full it arrives, and whether it carries an ultimate, scales with its **rarity**, so no two of the same weapon play exactly alike. You can then shape it further at the forge. See *Skills* for how kits roll, and *Crafting & Recycling* for reforging, refining, transmog, and turning unwanted weapons into Essence.

items: Your **Ring** — the vessel of your growth (see *Stats & the Ring*)

blocks.text: Each piece adds stats and defense; some carry set flavor or elemental properties.
Gear can be **refined** to higher plus-levels:

items: A **weapon** gains **+3 Attack per refine level**.
**Every** piece of gear gains **+1 Defense per refine level**.

blocks.text: So a +10 weapon is +30 Attack over its base, and any +10 piece is +10 Defense.

Gear comes in rarity tiers — **Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary** — which drive its border color and, loosely, how many **card slots** it has. For weapons, rarity also shapes the drop: higher rarity means more skills pre-filled, a better chance at an ultimate, and more crafting **Potential** (see *Crafting & Recycling*).
Higher-rarity gear has **card slots** you can socket with cards for monster-matchup bonuses. See **Cards**.

text: *Status: the 12-weapon roster and each weapon's one-line identity are locked in design; every weapon's exact skill pool and stats are being authored. Slots and the refinement rule are set.*
